label: L-06
title: WithdrawalExecuted event emits the Phase-1 cached balance rather than the actual amount transferred — produces misleading on-chain records that compound the CODE-001 discrepancy
description: WithdrawalExecuted emits withdrawAmount = state.balance (Phase-1 cached snapshot). ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._totalWithdraw ignores this value and operates on the live clientStoredBalance. When clientBalances grew between phases, the event records a smaller amount than actually transferred.
impact: Off-chain monitoring systems receive incorrect withdrawal amounts. The misleading event compresses the observability of the H-02 bug — community members watching for rugpull signals cannot detect inter-phase enlargement from the WithdrawalExecuted event alone.
attackPath: _totalWithdraw uses live clientStoredBalance which may be larger after inter-phase deposits
Event records smaller-than-actual amount; community monitoring cannot detect inter-phase enlargement from events alone
